ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast binary distribution: approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels localized in the central lobe regions and 35% low-intensity black pixels localized at the margins, tips, and central notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the central 75% of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous boundary along the trailing edge, terminal tips, and a broad triangular region at the central notch. Specific clusters of circular low-intensity blobs (mottling) are distributed across the white fields. Distal tips feature unique low-intensity concentric arc patterns.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees and a vertical depth reaching the lower third of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary with high-amplitude valleys and peaks. Significant jagged indentations are visible on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe and the central trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex outer margins tapering to pointed, slightly recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density spatial detection of circular low-intensity clusters (barnacle scars) primarily located in the upper-medial white regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible on the lower-central region of the left lobe (viewer's left).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular indentation/tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe (viewer's right). Distinctive concentric black arcuate scars on the dorsal-lateral corners of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Elongated horizontal dark mark resembling a 'dash' located on the lower-inner quadrant of the right lobe (viewer's right).
